books.title: Geometric measure theory and variational problems: a first reading
books.author: Stack Project of Geometric Measure Theory and Variational Problems contributors
books.description: Original exposition connecting classical GMT, BV compactness and perimeter minimization, current operations and Plateau existence, minimal surfaces, elliptic and Allard regularity, min-max theory, the volume spectrum, CMC variations and stability, and Allen-Cahn theory. Mean curvature flow includes evolution, comparison, Gaussian monotonicity, entropy, rescaling, and Brakke flow. Obstacle problems remain introductory. Exact source editions, hypotheses, and proof status are recorded.
